_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Every new serial connection now gets an automatic capture overview (HTML, Markdown and JSON), complete selected phase-event CSV, closed-file SHA-256 manifest and a readable capture index. The overview distinguishes idle/preflight connections from observed pressure protocols, explains the pressure column/range, and records sample counts, firmware, clocks, delivery and storage status. Protocol intent is logged locally without extra UART traffic.

Existing folder IDs and signal filenames remain compatible. Raw wire bytes, native signal precision, NI time/channels and complete traffic logs are retained. No firmware, PVR-estimator, calibration, pressure-control or safety-threshold changes.

Validation: 101 focused tests and eight standard GUI/protocol checks passed. Offline replay of retained v3.1.376 High Max simulator wire preserved all 7,667 device samples and exact RX bytes; both mirrors and every closed-file hash matched. This host-only update does not claim a new physical soak. MATLAB functions and the short algorithm PDF are included unchanged.

Application v3.1.377; firmware rev27v-followup-351. Source default e2a38e8fadac196cb84510ba35b58660653cd529. Unsigned build/publication follows the operator-authorized AllowUnsigned policy.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
